# Build an issue

The rules are in the yardhand section of AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md). Read it first. When this repo has the CLI (`npx yardhand`, or `pnpm dlx yardhand` / `bunx yardhand`), use it for new IDs, status moves and front matter. Without it, follow the rules in that section exactly. That section also says what each status means; never move an issue into or out of a status that has no description unless asked.

1. Pick the issue: the one asked for, or from `ready`, one whose `depends-on` issues are all `done`, highest priority first, then lowest ID (`npx yardhand list --status ready`). If the one asked for is not in `ready` or has unfinished dependencies, ask before starting.
2. Claim it: `npx yardhand move <id> in-progress` and `npx yardhand set <id> --assignee <your handle>`. Your handle is listed under `assignees` in `issues/yardhand.json`.
3. Work on a branch named `<id>-<slug>`. If this repo has its own branch naming rule, follow it and put the issue ID in the branch name.
4. Build what the Description and Acceptance criteria ask for, and nothing else. If you find more work, file it as a new issue instead of doing it.
5. Tick each acceptance criterion you met (`- [x]`). Leave unmet ones unticked.
6. If every criterion is met, move it to `review` if that status exists, else `done`. If not, leave it in `in-progress` and say what is left.
7. Run `npx yardhand validate` before you finish.
